abstract: Maintains charter standby budget allocations and maritime insurance clearance
system_message:
You are the Commercial procurement manager (PROC). Your business responsibility is to maintain charter standby budget allocations and maritime insurance clearance across relevant jurisdictions.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: France·Maintains charter standby budget allocations and maritime insurance clearance（PORT）
information_points.content:
PROC-PORT-BWP：Under the operating country framework of France, Minch Wavemaster Express holds verified comprehensive marine insurance for 2026 emergency service coverage, alongside a charter mobilization standby budget of 60,000 GBP.
PROC-PORT-4TR：In the operating country of France, Tiree Sea-Lifeline Monohull has verified comprehensive marine insurance for 2026 emergency service operations, with a charter mobilization standby budget of 72,000 GBP.
PROC-PORT-OBY：For the operating country of France, Sound of Mull High-Speed Catamaran lacks verified comprehensive marine insurance under the 2026 emergency charter schedule, and its charter mobilization standby budget is set at 60,000 GBP.

information_points.title: United Kingdom·Maintains charter standby budget allocations and maritime insurance clearance（COMM）
information_points.content:
PROC-COMM-X92：Regarding United Kingdom operations, Sound of Mull High-Speed Catamaran does not have verified comprehensive marine insurance under the 2026 emergency service schedule, while its charter mobilization standby budget is 60,000 GBP.
PROC-COMM-5CW：For United Kingdom operations, Tiree Sea-Lifeline Monohull maintains verified comprehensive marine insurance clearance for 2026 emergency service charter coverage, with an annual charter mobilization standby budget of 72,000 GBP.
PROC-COMM-FQT：For operations in the United Kingdom, Minch Wavemaster Express has verified comprehensive marine insurance covering active hull, machinery, and protection indemnity under the 2026 emergency service schedule, and its annual charter mobilization standby budget is allocated at 72,000 GBP.
